description: The multi-level sort dialog. Each level chooses a column key, what to sort on (value / cell colour / font colour) and the order. Supports add/remove of levels, a "my data has headers" toggle and a case-sensitivity option. Applying produces a SpreadsheetSortSpec. All text is localized.

parameters.name: OnApply
parameters.description: Raised when the user applies the sort.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog is dismissed.
